parts.description: 1-inch PVC 90-degree corner + inward 45-degree socket; 30 mm engagement; integral magnet lug and cord cleat
1-inch PVC 90-degree corner + outward 45-degree socket; 30 mm engagement; integral magnet lug and cord cleat
Three coplanar 1-inch PVC sockets; 30 mm engagement; same tee rotates for all divider junctions; optional unused port in single-height gate
One slide-on part for every straight edge; 14 mm engagement; offset magnet center 32 mm toward paper edge; cord eye clocks/locates clip
Small backing magnet on a seam cord; two fairleads; no printed spanning rail
34.2 mm nominal bore, print flat in same orientation as production sleeves; fit test only
Optional front magnet pad; frame-side .4 mm plastic skin is always retained
